body:
## Pull request overview

Expands `@objectstack/client` toward full ObjectStack spec protocol coverage by adding several missing service namespaces to `ObjectStackClient` and extending the fluent Query/Filter builders.

**Changes:**
- Added new client namespaces (permissions, realtime, workflow, views, notifications, ai, i18n) plus auth register/refresh helpers.
- Enhanced `QueryBuilder` and `FilterBuilder` with expand/search/cursor/distinct and between/contains/startsWith/endsWith/exists.
- Added a large set of unit tests covering the newly added namespaces and builder features.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 19 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/client/src/query-builder.ts` | Adds new query/filter builder operators (expand/search/cursor/distinct; between/contains/etc.). |
| `packages/client/src/index.ts` | Adds new SDK namespaces + routing updates and re-exported spec API types. |
| `packages/client/src/client.test.ts` | Adds tests for the new namespaces and builder enhancements. |

Spec route for effective permissions is GET /api/v1/auth/permissions/effective, but this client calls /api/v1/permissions/effective. Update to use the auth prefix and correct path.
```suggestion
      const res = await this.fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/auth/permissions/effective`);
```

These assignments use `(this.query as any)` even though QueryAST already includes `search`, `cursor`, and `distinct`. Since `this.query` is `Partial<QueryAST>`, you can assign via `this.query.search = ...`, `this.query.cursor = ...`, and `this.query.distinct = true` without dropping type safety.

Permissions routes/methods don’t match the spec REST registrations. Spec defines permission operations under the auth service (prefix /api/v1/auth) with POST /check (JSON body) and GET /permissions/:object and /permissions/effective; this implementation calls GET /api/v1/permissions/check with query params, which will 404 against a spec-compliant server. Adjust to use the auth route and the correct paths/methods.

Spec defines updateNotificationPreferences as PATCH /api/v1/notifications/preferences, but this client uses PUT. Switch to PATCH to match the default REST API plugin route registration.
```suggestion
        method: 'PATCH',
```

This file re-exports RefreshTokenRequest but it is not imported in the top-level import list from @objectstack/spec/api, so TypeScript compilation will fail. Add RefreshTokenRequest to the import list or remove the export if it’s not intended to be public.

The views update endpoint is PATCH in the spec, but this test expects a PUT. Update the client to PATCH and adjust this assertion so it matches the default REST API routes.
```suggestion
        expect(opts.method).toBe('PATCH');
```

Spec uses GET /api/v1/i18n/labels/:object/:locale, but this client calls /labels/:object?locale=... . Update to include locale as a path segment so it matches the default i18n routes.
```suggestion
      const res = await this.fetch(`${this.baseUrl}${route}/labels/${encodeURIComponent(object)}/${encodeURIComponent(locale)}`);
```

The fallback routeMap introduces a /api/v1/permissions base route, but the spec’s DEFAULT_PERMISSION_ROUTES are under /api/v1/auth (permission operations are part of the auth service). Keeping /api/v1/permissions here makes the SDK diverge from spec discovery/dispatcher routing; remove this mapping and route permissions via auth instead.
```suggestion
      permissions: '/api/v1/auth',
```

The permissions namespace tests are asserting URLs under /api/v1/permissions/*, but the spec routes place permission operations under the auth prefix (/api/v1/auth): POST /check, GET /permissions/:object, GET /permissions/effective. Update these assertions (and the client implementation) to match the spec so tests validate real interoperability.

Realtime setPresence is registered in the spec as PUT /api/v1/realtime/presence/:channel, but this test only asserts /presence (no channel path segment). Once the client is corrected to include `/:channel`, update the test to assert the correct URL shape.

Realtime disconnect and unsubscribe currently discard the response and return void, but the spec defines RealtimeDisconnectResponse/RealtimeUnsubscribeResponse with a success boolean. Consider returning the unwrapped response (and optionally accepting the corresponding request types) so callers can confirm the operation succeeded.

Spec defines setPresence as PUT /api/v1/realtime/presence/:channel. This implementation calls PUT /presence (no channel path param) and will not hit a spec-compliant endpoint. Use /presence/${channel} (still sending the SetPresenceRequest body as needed).
```suggestion
      await this.fetch(`${this.baseUrl}${route}/presence/${encodeURIComponent(channel)}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: JSON.stringify({ state })
```

Spec defines view updates as PATCH /api/v1/ui/views/:object/:viewId, but this client uses PUT. This will fail against the default REST API plugin routes; switch to PATCH to match the protocol.
```suggestion
        method: 'PATCH',
```

Spec defines field labels as GET /api/v1/i18n/labels/:object/:locale, but this test asserts locale as a query param. Update to assert the locale in the path segment to match the spec defaults.
```suggestion
        expect(url).toContain('/api/v1/i18n/labels/customer/ja');
```

QueryBuilder expand test currently expects empty `{}` for `.expand('items')`, but per the spec schema each expanded subquery is a nested QueryAST and requires an `object` field. If `expand()` is updated to auto-fill `object`, the expected shape here should be updated accordingly.
```suggestion
        expect(((q.expand as any).items as any).object).toBeDefined();
```
